metaDescription: Mike Fuller Electric won our 2026 Electrical Contracting award for Ottawa, Ontario. Licensed since 1987, serving Ottawa, Nepean, Kanata and Orleans.
summary: Mike Fuller Electric is a licensed, family-owned electrical contractor serving Ottawa, Nepean, Kanata, Orleans and Barrhaven. In business since 1987, the company handles residential and commercial electrical work from panel upgrades to EV charger installation.

editorial.heading: What they do
editorial.text: Mike Fuller Electric handles service panel upgrades, EV charger installation, home rewiring, aluminum wiring repair, pot light installation and renovation electrical. That range spans routine safety upgrades, like replacing aluminum wiring, to modern additions, like installing an EV charger, under one licensed electrician.

editorial.heading: How they work
editorial.text: As a licensed contractor, work should be permitted and inspected through the Electrical Safety Authority, Ontario's electrical regulator, particularly for panel upgrades and rewiring. Being family-owned since 1987 gives the business a long operating history in the Ottawa market, which is worth asking about directly if you want references from past decades of work.

editorial.heading: What to expect
editorial.text: No customer reviews are published for this listing yet, so ask the company directly for recent references, especially for a job similar in scope to yours, whether that is a panel upgrade, an EV charger, or renovation wiring. A licensed electrician should be able to provide their Electrical Contractor Registration Agency, or ECRA, licence number on request.

editorial.heading: Where they work
editorial.text: The company serves Ottawa and surrounding communities including Nepean, Kanata, Orleans and Barrhaven. This covers most of the urban and suburban Ottawa area, so confirm coverage if your address is further out in the rural surrounding region.
